system.description:
The sky chokes into a purple rage and voices its displeasure with searing thunderbolts. Damaging effect spell: Power = Will +5, VA 6. Die of Fate to determine IMS. Weapon Length: as Missile; Range: as Heavy Crossbow +1D.

Obstacle: 6^. Actions: 20.

Origin: Sight | Area of Effect: 10s of Paces | Element: White/Air | Impetus: Destroy | Duration: Instantaneous | Resource Points: 24

^ When pricing this spell in resource points, it costs 4 rps per point of obstacle rather than 2.

Source: Burning Wheel Gold Revised, p. 220
